meaning:
ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32:21, 3Ma.3:8 * ;]
1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, 1Co.10:32.
2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: Act.24:16, Php.1:10 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)
glosses: do not become a stumbling block

renderings.bsb: Do not become a stumbling block

elsewhere.note: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
